descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Telecomunicații, Servicii IT și consultanță IT și Tehnologie, informații și mass-media
How would you like to work in IT, toying with cutting edge technologies and enjoying your life? At Orange Services, it’s possible!
 As one of the largest IT Hub within Orange Group, we are working internationally for both Orange corporate functions and country operations. Through a unique combination of know-how and expertise, our teams provide a broad range of IT & Business Solutions.
 Come closer to #LifeAtOrange!
 What we’re looking for: 
Join the team that designs and delivers the network layer of Orange Telco Cloud (OTC IaaS & CaaS) to Orange subsidiaries across Europe, the Middle East and Africa.
You will own low-level network design, integration and qualification for the platform where physical network, SDN and Kubernetes clusters meet.
Orange Telco Cloud runs in production across Orange subsidiaries in Europe, the Middle East and Africa, hosting telco network functions (VNFs and CNFs) — and it keeps growing, with 5G Core workloads on the roadmap.
 This is senior network & security design engineering, applied to a telco cloud platform at Orange Group scale.
Your work sits upstream of deployment: you design and qualify the network architecture of OTC before it reaches production.
You split your time between design (LLDs, defining flow matrix, HA data-center architectures), new solutions qualification (lab validation of network components for functionality, performance, scalability and redundancy, with automated regression) and technology exploration (prototyping and evaluating new open-source networking approaches for hosting VNFs / CNFs).
 What you'll be doing: 
 Design & deliver: 
Produce and maintain engineering and LLD templates for OTC deployments — rack and server layouts, network equipment, cabling, logical configuration, firewall permitted flows.
Design and maintain the local lab infrastructure used to qualify the SDN component of OTC IaaS and networking components of OTC CaaS.
Define integration design between OTC IaaS/CaaS and customers' existing network infrastructure (routing, peering, security).
Maintain lifecycle management (LCM) of software releases for OTC networking hardware — switches and firewalls — in coordination with Technology Skill Centers and lab validation.
 Guide & automate: 
Build configuration guides for routers, switches and firewalls deployed as part of IaaS / CaaS.
Deliver automation tooling to verify cabling and generate network configurations.
Advise Orange country teams and Corporate Technical Centers on OTC network, SDN and vendor equipment behavior.
Create & keep the platform's network integration documentation.
Guide operational teams on networking issues related to OTC deployments.
 What you need to know / have: 
Solid grounding in network protocols — TCP/IP, routing (OSPF, IS-IS, BGP), MPLS VPN, EVPN, VXLAN
Data-center IP fabric design for high availability — spine-leaf, BGP underlay, EVPN-VXLAN overlay
Hands-on with network and security equipment from major vendors — Juniper, Cisco, Arista, Nokia, Fortigate
Kubernetes networking — CNI plugins (Calico, Cilium), Multus for multi-interface pods, network policies, service load balancing (MetalLB, BGP peering with the fabric)
Linux networking (RHEL / Ubuntu) — bridges, VLANs, bonding, namespaces, iptables, nftables, Open vSwitch; comfortable with container networking
Scripting and automation —Shell, Python, Git, REST APIs
Advanced packet-capture analysis for troubleshooting
 Nice to have (any of these is a plus): 
High-performance networking for CNFs — SR-IOV, DPDK, hugepages, NUMA / CPU pinning
Networking for VMs on Kubernetes (KubeVirt)
SDN — Juniper Contrail, OpenStack Neutron / OVN
Ingress / Gateway API / Egress gateways
Test automation frameworks — RobotFramework, Jenkins, Ansible
Network security design — segmentation, firewall policy
Telco background — VNF / CNF integration, 5G Core or RAN network requirements
QA experience applied to networking
Experience delivering network designs to multiple geographies and customer teams
 Profile: 
Senior: 5+ years in network design and engineering, ideally in a data-center or telco cloud context.
Able to own LLDs end-to-end, consult across multiple technologies, and apply network automation.
 The team: 
An international team with colleagues across Orange affiliates, delivering Orange Telco Cloud guidelines to subsidiaries across Europe, the Middle East and Africa.
You will work directly with Orange Corporate Skill Centers & vendor support.
 What’s in it for you: 
Performance Bonuses – based on your results & the company’s;
Electronic Meal Tickets
Medical & Life insurance for you - facilities for your family, too;
#WFH & Flexible hours;
Professional GSM subscription;
Personal GSM subscription, also [because we believe in communication!];
Special grants on Smartphones & devices; discounts for Orange products & services;
Development Platforms - Orange Learning, Trainings, Career Counselling, Coaching & Career plan mentoring;
Wellbeing Programs – we support your Zen;
 Orange Services is about bringing together people and technology.
 Come & work for a #TopEmployer company. You could be part of an organization where great colleagues and team spirit support your professional development.
 At Orange, you can.
 IMPORTANT 
 In order to be able to follow your application status and receive relevant notifications, make sure to complete your application in our ATS (applicant tracking system), by following the redirection link. Once this step is completed, you will receive a confirmation email from Orange that your application has been successfully registered. 
 We encourage all candidate profiles, regardless of gender, age, race, citizenship, ethnicity, color, language, religion, social origin, genetic traits, sexual orientation, permanent or temporary disability, nationality, political choice, social category or social origins, situation or family responsibility, belonging to a disadvantaged category, membership or trade union activity.
